subject: Helix Health — access custody & SCIM/SAML evidence request
messages:
From: Ellen Foster <ellen.foster@helixhealth.com>
To: irene.choi@redwoodinference.com
Cc: security@helixhealth.com
Date: 2027-03-21T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence request: SCIM deltas, SAML assertions, RBAC mapping

Hi Irene,

Thanks for taking this. As part of Helix Health's vendor SIG assessment and our SOC 2 refresh, we need a short bundle of IAM artifacts to validate our access controls and provisioning flows. Could you provide the following by EOD 2027-03-25: 

- SCIM delta logs (CSV) showing user provisioning/deprovisioning for the last 6 months (timestamp, actor, action, user_id, external_id).
- A set of sampled SAML assertion XMLs for service accounts and legacy SSO flows (no PII; redact as needed).
- An access ownership matrix (XLSX) listing role -> owner -> justification, including service accounts and delegated admin roles.
- Brief note (1 page max) describing how least-privilege is enforced for service accounts and any short-lived/ephemeral admin flows.

We prefer a secure Drive share (or SFTP) and a short mutual action plan so we can close this in SIG. If any scope is unclear, flag it and we'll triage.

Thanks,
Ellen Foster
Head of Security, Helix Health
ellen.foster@helixhealth.com

Ellen — thanks for the clear list. We're on it. High-level plan: 

1) Scoping call (if needed) by 2027-03-22 to confirm exact CSV columns and redaction policy.
2) Engineering extracts + redact (SCIM/SAML) by 2027-03-23.
3) Delivery to secure Drive and a short summary note by 2027-03-24.

I'll coordinate extraction with Jordan for SCIM deltas and with Priyom for the service-account ownership rollup. Marissa (cc'd) will prepare the ownership matrix template.

Please confirm Drive share or SFTP preference and whether you need any attestations (signed cover letter) for SOC 2 evidence ingestion.

—Irene

- Ownership matrix: Marissa will populate role owner and justification; I'll add notes on delegation paths for service accounts.
